status: prospective local feasibility specification, not independent preregistration
information: All policies share exact specified calibrated Gaussian prior/noise covariances and the same probe observations. Latent displacement and actuator realizations are evaluator-only. Exact covariance knowledge is an optimistic feasibility assumption, not a learned-noise demonstration.
scope: Ideal bypass and additive Gaussian correction disturbance; no state-dependent actuator error, bypass loss, actuator noise correlation, noise drift, hardware, latency target or unique SEFI derivation.
analysis: Report every actuator setting. Seed-paired bootstrap intervals are exploratory descriptive, not a confirmatory superiority or novelty claim. Include a conventional minimum-MSE gate and independent Gauss-Hermite expected-fidelity integration.
